explanation: Supplements and protein products (not 'Proteinquellen' on plant-based burgers)
Meat substitutes (diet labels such as 'vegetarisch' are not used)
Hummus (grouped with sandwich salads as at AH and Jumbo)
Cooking oil (before spreads so peanut oil is not a spread)
Cheese (before spreads so cheese spreads count as cheese)
Coffee, tea and sweeteners ('Getränke mit Süßstoff' and 'Gezuckerte Getränke' are soft drinks)
Sauces soups spices oil and canned food
Food without a more specific label
